say:1:1430111101:1.text: Thanks, but my so-called creativity is actually because I'm short of coin.
say:1:1430111101:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的夸奖，但所谓的创意其实全是因为我囊中羞涩。
say:1:1430111101:1.male: Thanks, but my so-called creativity is actually because I'm short of coin.

say:2:1430111102:1.text: I don't have that much money so I can only craft something... but crafting is so normal in our village.
say:2:1430111102:1.source_cn: 我没有钱，就只会锻造……可锻造在深岩村中实在太过常见……

say:3:1430111103:1.text: Will she really accept something from a normal guy like me?
say:3:1430111103:1.source_cn: 她真的会接受像我这样普通的矮人吗？
